
# @rohan9024/llmrouter v2.0.0 — Full Technical Reference

## Installation

```bash
npm install @rohan9024/llmrouter
```

## Core Usage

```typescript
import { Router } from '@rohan9024/llmrouter';

const router = new Router({
  models: [
    'openai/gpt-5-mini',
    'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5',
    'groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b',
  ],
  strategy: 'balanced',
  retry: {
    maxRetriesPerTarget: 1,
    maxTotalAttempts: 4,
    respectRetryAfter: true,
  },
  circuitBreaker: {
    enabled: true,
    failureThreshold: 5,
    openDurationMs: 30_000,
  },
  timeout: {
    perAttemptMs: 10_000,
    totalTimeoutMs: 30_000,
  },
});

const res = await router.chat.completions.create({
  messages: [
    { role: 'user', content: 'Hello!' },
  ],
});

console.log(res.choices[0].message.content);
console.log(res._routerMeta);
```

## Explain & Stats

- `router.explain(request, options?)`: Explains the selected model, selection reasons, and rejected candidates.
- `router.stats()`: Returns request counts, P50/P95 latencies, cost totals, and per-model circuit states.

## CLI Reference

```bash
# Initialize a project
npx @rohan9024/llmrouter init --yes

# Diagnose configuration
npx @rohan9024/llmrouter doctor --json

# Discover models supporting tools and vision
npx @rohan9024/llmrouter models --tools --vision

# Explain routing decisions
npx @rohan9024/llmrouter explain --models openai/gpt-5-mini,ollama/llama3 --vision --json

# Benchmark models and recommend a routing policy
npx @rohan9024/llmrouter benchmark --dataset eval.jsonl --recommend-policy
```
